Patella zentriert stehend. Mehrere oberflächliche, teils bis zur Hälfte der Knorpelschicht erreichenden chondralen Läsionen (siehe z. B. 7/9). Chondrale Calcinosis femoropatellar, führend retropatellar (z. B. 3/46 und 3/57). Ansonsten erhaltene Knorpelbelag.

Femorotibial lateralseitig erhaltener Knorpelbelag ohne tief greifende Chondropathie jedoch mit auffallender chondraler Calcinosis (z. B. 4/25). Der Außenmeniskus ist intakt.

Medialseitig teils fokal tief greifende Chondropathie (z. B. 6/10 oder 4/23) in der Hauptbelastungszone der Femurkondyle. Ansonsten vorwiegend oberflächliche Chondropathie. Hier nur sehr geringe Chondrokalzinose. Der Innenmeniskus ab Pars intermedia bis ins Hinterhorn deutlich signalalteriert und aufgetrieben mit schräger Risskomponente (z. B. 5/9) und kleiner meniscealer Zyste (4/19). Diskrete osteophytäre Anbauten (1005/73).

Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt, geringer Reizzustand des MCL. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Synovialis nicht verdickt. Vergrößerte Bursa praepatellaris (5/20). Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und der Subkutis.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion with synovitis. Large complex popliteal cyst measuring up to 65 mm with an 11 mm osseous body in the superior aspect of the cyst. Sliver of free fluid along the inferior margin of the popliteal cyst suggesting minimal recent partial rupture.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Moderate degenerative change.
Complex degenerative tear with a dominant longitudinal horizontal oblique component of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with inferior surfacing. Fraying and blunting of the meniscal free edge.
Mild thickening of the proximal MCL compatible with remote injury.
Diffuse low grade partial-thickness chondral loss. Marginal osteophytosis.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Severe degenerative change with full-thickness chondral loss of the weightbearing and posterior portion of the compartment, with subchondral reactive marrow change. Marginal osteophytosis.
Complex degenerative multidirectional tear of the posterior horn extending into the body with significant maceration and substance loss of the body and anterior and posterior horn with minimal residual meniscal substance. There is some extrusion of the body of the lateral meniscus.
Thickened popliteus insertion with intrasubstance signal compatible with moderate tendinosis
Mildly thickened lateral collateral ligament proper which could reflect the sequela of a remote injury. Mild distal biceps tendinosis.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Degenerative changes of the anterior cruciate ligament which remains intact. The PCL is intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild chondropathy. Small marginal osteophytes. Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis. Mild edema at the suprapatellar fat pad.
Scarring at that the Hoffa's fat pad which could reflect the previous surgery-for clinical correlation.

Bones:
See above.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
The intra-articular body is seen at the suprapatellar joint recess on the previous MRI is no longer present.

CONCLUSION:
1.Interval worsening of the severe osteoarthritis of the lateral compartment. Complex degenerative tearing and extensive maceration the lateral meniscus.
2.Moderate degenerative change of the medial compartment. Complex degenerative tear with a dominant longitudinal oblique tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus.
3.Mild degenerative change of the patellofemoral compartment.
4.Large complex popliteal cyst with an osseous body.

candidate_cells.original_evidence:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión meniscal medial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Aumento de señal difuso del LCA, sin signos que sugieran rotura categórica. LCP y ligamentos
colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. El
resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

candidate_cells.original_evidence: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Tibyal platonun posterolateral köşesinde kemik kontüzyonu ile uyumlu subkondral ödem gözleniyor. Ön çapraz bağda tam kat - tam kata  yakın yırtık mevcut. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar korunmuş. Medial patellar snovyal plika eklem aralığına interpoze değil. Medyal ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal. Gastrokinemyus-semimembranozus bursasındaki septalı ve lobüle konturlu sıvı lokülasyonu en çok 7,8 cm boyutlu ve sızdırıyor.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Grade 3 (complete disruption) injury of the distal medial collateral ligament noted. The mid and proximal collateral ligament is thickened with intrinsic high signal abnormality. There is extensive periligamentous edema.

There is some blunting and fraying of the free edge of the body of the medial meniscus suggestive of a small radial tear or defect.

The articular cartilage is unremarkable.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
The articular cartilage is unremarkable. The lateral meniscus and lateral collateral ligament complex appear normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
High-grade partial, functionally complete or complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.

The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild diffuse chondropathy is noted with superficial fraying noted on both sides of the joint, best appreciated at the median ridge of the patellar articular cartilage and in the trochlear groove. At the lateral trochlea however, there are focal areas of high-grade fissuring and delamination.

Bones:
There is a tiny subchondral impaction fracture at the posterolateral aspect of the lateral tibial plateau with associated moderate bone marrow edema.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

1.There is a tiny subchondral impaction fracture at the posterolateral aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.
2.Grade 3 injury of the medial collateral ligament noted with complete disruption distally.
3.High-grade partial, functionally complete or complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
4.Patellofemoral chondropathy with high-grade fissuring and delamination noted involving the lateral trochlea as detailed above.
5.There is some blunting and fraying of the free edge of the body of the medial meniscus suggestive of a small radial tear or defect.
